related_features.name: Robots and explicit sitemaps
related_features.acceptance_test: Load a sitemap index, gzipped child sitemap and explicit input; handle loops/malformed XML safely.

implementation_evidence.proves: Robots/explicit sitemap inputs, nested sitemap indexes, multiple explicit origins, XML escaping, malformed-root rejection and bounded/seen discovery exist and are fixture-tested.

Actual native explicit duplicate roots, recursive index/self-cycle, duplicate compressed child and malformed XML retain original occurrences, complete-source facts and bounded deduplication. Current workspace includes parser/transport/ledger cases. Independent discovery acceptance is met; vendor parity is unproven.

related_features.name: Sitemap coverage and orphan checks
related_features.acceptance_test: Compare fetched pages and sitemap locations; distinguish not listed, sitemap-only and incomplete crawl.

implementation_evidence.proves: Sitemap-only locations are fetched with discovery source; observed graph orphan candidates explicitly retain incomplete/limited coverage boundaries.

Actual same-transaction inventory permits qualified Complete/KnownEmpty/Unknown for current or historical declared sources; missing/denied/incomplete sources remain unknown, invalid Page Locs separate. Target/inlink joins and full website coverage remain open.

remaining_acceptance: Join persisted original memberships to fetched page and inlink observations, distinguishing not-listed, sitemap-only, pending, unavailable and historical evidence without inventing whole-website completeness.

related_features.name: Sitemap URL validation
related_features.acceptance_test: Find redirect/non-200/non-indexable URLs and invalid lastmod values in fixture XML.

implementation_evidence.proves: Discovered sitemap locations receive ordinary status/indexability observations and errors.

Raw lastmod fields retained and assessed against named XSD1.0 date|dateTime and W3C precision profiles; actual API/SDK/browser handle calendar errors, duplicate elements, incomplete prefixes and undetermined leap seconds. Target redirect/non200/nonindexable findings remain open.

remaining_acceptance: Produce explicit sitemap target redirect/non200/nonindexable findings from actual page observations; preserve original membership beside rewritten fetch identities.
